title: #342 Experience or Book
prompt: Knowledge gained from experience is more important than knowledge gained from books. To what extent do you agree with this statement?

promptSegments.text: Knowledge gained from experience is more important than knowledge gained from books.
To what extent do you agree with this statement?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

modelPlan.focus: Explore the comparative importance of experiential and book-derived knowledge, arguing that both are essential for comprehensive understanding.
keyArguments: Experiential knowledge provides practical insights and real-world application, which enhances understanding beyond theoretical concepts.
Book-derived knowledge lays the foundational theories and frameworks necessary for contextualizing experiences.
